final: WITH frequency_counts AS (SELECT a.frequency, COUNT(*) AS frequency_count FROM disp AS d JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = d.account_id GROUP BY a.frequency), totals AS (SELECT SUM(frequency_count) AS total_count, AVG(frequency_count) AS average_count FROM frequency_counts) SELECT f.frequency, f.frequency_count, 1.0 * f.frequency_count / t.total_count AS fraction_of_total, 1.0 * f.frequency_count / t.average_count AS fraction_of_average FROM frequency_counts AS f CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL AND t.average_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY f.frequency
